PLANET LABS PUBLIC ORBITAL EPHEMERIDES

Planet Labs performs orbit determination on its own satellites from GPS and 2-way
UHF ranging and provides this data publicly in various formats.
Technical reference: https://arxiv.org/abs/1509.03270


=== 18 SPCS matching ===
Provides best-guess matching between 18 SPCS CATID and Planet Labs HWID.
Not always consistant due to 18 SPCS cross-tagging.
https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/18SPCS_matches_v1.txt


=== Operational Status ===
Provides operational status of Planet Labs satellites.

A Satellite is designated as "Operational" if Planet is currently
able to maneuver the satellite (either propulsively or via differential drag),
and/or respond to a conjunction event. Otherwise, it is designated as
"Nonoperational". A satellite being "operational" does not imply we are actively
publishing ephemeris for that satellite. We only publish updates to our O/O
ephemeris when we have sufficient telemetry to generate a high-quality state.

Disclaimer: The information provided is intended to be accurate
only as of the date of publication and Planet undertakes no obligation to
update this information to reflect current or future events or circumstances.
For accurate information with respect to space situational coordination,
please email orbital-neighbors [at] planet [dot] com if required.

https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/operational_status_v1.txt


=== TLEs ===
TLEs are only published for "Operational" (see above) satellites.
Latest:     https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/planet_mc.tle
Historical: https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/planet_mc_YYYYMMDD.tle


=== State Vectors ===
States are only published for "Operational" (see above) satellites.
Latest:     https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/planet.states
Historical: https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/planet_YYYYMMDD.states

State vector file format:
  Col1: Satellite Hardware ID (HWID, a 4-digit hex number)
  Col2: Epoch in [s] since J2000 epoch Terrestrial Time
  Col3,4,5: Position in J2000 frame [m]
  Col6,7,8: Velocity in J2000 frame [m/s]
  Col9: Drag Ballistic coefficient in [kg/m2]
  Col10: SRP ballistic coefficient in [kg/m2] (not currently fit)


=== Ephemeris predictions ===
Per-satellite 5-day ephemeris prediction:
https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/HWID_oem.txt

SkySat 95-day ephemeris prediction:
https://ephemerides.planet-labs.com/HWID_long_term_oem.txt

where HWID is the satellite ID (see 18 SPCS matching for HWID-CATID conversions)
